title: Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Tier and Ridgeline Tool Rental Refuelling
content:
Premier and Preferred Ridgeline Consumer Credit cardholders pay a lower Ridgeline Tool Rental refuelling charge.

**Benefit.** The Ridgeline Consumer Credit tier lowers the refuelling charge: when the renter's Ridgeline Consumer Credit account is active at the Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Premier tier, it is multiplied by 0.90; when it is active at the Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Preferred tier, by 0.95; in every other case it is unchanged.

The multiplier acts on the priced refuelling, service fee included, and the rounding to the cent is made only on the final figure.

The tier and status read are those on the renter's Ridgeline Consumer Credit account record.

| Ridgeline Consumer Credit account | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Premier, active | 0.90 |
| Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Preferred, active | 0.95 |
| Classic, a Project Loan, any tier not active, or no account | 1 (unchanged) |

## Hypothetical figures (priced refuelling of 69.00, service fee included)

| Account | Figure |
|---|---|
| Premier, active | 62.10 |
| Preferred, active | 65.55 |
| Preferred, closed | 69.00 |
